text: The crumbled curd is packed tightly into a salted animal skin and ripened in a cool cave or cellar for about six months. The skin acts as the casing, and residual whey can drain through holes in its sides.

steps.name: pack in skin
steps.note: The curd is put into a salted goatskin, called a tulum.
Salt is also put on top, in the skin.
The cheese is ripened in a cave or cellar.
